wwo.name: Lille
wwo.method: Partial candidate. Adds the Fives railway fringe, Rue de Bavay and the mapped northern part of the Champ de Manœuvres to the Old Lille, Wazemmes, Saint-Maurice and Béthune areas. Roads, traced footprints and open ground are separately sourced. The undigitized parts of the sheet and the field continue outside the interpreted coverage.

registration.reference: Lille IGN PLAN z14 control mosaic displayed at 288 px per input tile. The original seven approximate ties are retained; modern contours are used only for registration.

controls.name: Porte d’Arras approach (formerly mislabeled as Porte des Postes)

sources.title: Plan de la ville de Lille, librairie Ch. Tallandier
sources.licence: Public domain historical map. Original WWO transcription and interpretation.
sources.precision: Centerline and group footprints digitized in a scanned city plan. Local affine fit with approximate modern control. Pink block hatch is not an individual cadastre.

sources.title: IGN PLAN reference mosaic
sources.licence: Etalab Open License 2.0. No modern features copied to historical plan.
sources.precision: Modern IGN PLAN raster at z14, displayed at 288 pixels per tile in the control mosaic; used only for control.

sources.title: Délibérations du conseil municipal, séance du 29 juillet 1892, page 392
sources.licence: Public municipal record. Only the street names and itinerary are cited.
sources.precision: The proposed Cormontaigne–Place des Postes tram route confirms the Boulevard Montebello itinerary. The record states the lines had not been built; it is not used to draw a tram line.

sources.title: Laissez-vous conter le Faubourg de Béthune
sources.publisher: Ville de Lille, service du patrimoine
sources.licence: Citation only; no booklet image distributed.
sources.precision: Confirms the old Béthune route, the building strip beyond the military glacis, and early workers’ dwellings. Street geometry comes from the 1898 plan. No later buildings shown in the booklet are imported.

sources.title: Archives départementales du Nord, 2 R 465: Lille et Ronchin, Champ de manœuvres
sources.licence: Archival catalogue citation only. No document image distributed.
sources.precision: The 1897 acquisition record establishes military use in Lille and Ronchin. Ground geometry is transcribed separately from the 1898 Tallandier plan.

sources.title: Délibérations municipales de Lille, désignations des voies publiques, pp. 84–87
sources.licence: Archival citation only. No document image distributed.
sources.precision: Records the place de Valenciennes and designates the extra-mural route as rue du Faubourg-de-Valenciennes. All cartographic geometry uses the 1898 town plan.
